basics.name: Sajad Rahimi
basics.label: Technical Lead | Senior Software Engineer | Scalable Systems
basics.summary: Technical lead and senior software engineer with 10+ years of experience building financial, travel, and SaaS platforms. Skilled in distributed systems, microservices, performance optimization, and leading engineering teams across products. Hands-on with PHP/Laravel, Node.js/NestJS, TypeScript, and AI-assisted development. Creator of AI Worker, a self-hosted tool for automating software development and code review.

work.name: Directam
work.summary: Led architecture and engineering across Directam, Directam Plus, and Avat, modernizing high-volume messaging infrastructure and integrating AI capabilities.
highlights: Led multiple engineering teams and the transition from a monolithic architecture to distributed microservices.
Increased infrastructure load-handling capacity by more than 100× compared with the previous architecture, enabling horizontal scaling.
Introduced asynchronous processing and queues using Redis, Laravel Queues, and Horizon while reducing reliance on a central database.
Implemented centralized logging and monitoring and contributed to AI-powered automated messaging.

work.name: Iranicard (Paliz Group)
work.summary: Led engineering initiatives across Iranicard’s financial platform and launched Pateh, a travel booking platform built from the ground up.
highlights: Helped modernize Iranicard’s backend toward microservices; worked on payments, wallets, transaction processing, accounting flows, and financial-data security.
Started Pateh as its sole developer, then built and led multiple teams as the product expanded.
Designed and developed 25+ microservices and integrated 20+ APIs for flights, hotels, buses, tours, and travel insurance.
Built a flight search engine handling 10,000+ requests per second, with sub-second responses for 90% of searches, using caching and search-result management.
Integrated with Safarmarket, achieving competitive search-result placement through fast API response times.

work.name: Amreton
work.summary: Developed backend APIs and services for a ride-hailing and logistics platform.
highlights: Built passenger and driver services with Laravel and Node.js; improved ride assignment using WebSocket.
